Best,
Robbie

messages.author: aa7b5c73c3a6760a
messages.subject: Re: After all iterations, get error "*** caught segfault ***" when Calculating INFO and HWE
parts:
Hi,

Looks like your job ran out of RAM during the writing part. For very large samples, you can use the parameter "outputSNPBlockSize" to control how many SNPs are written to disk at once, and hence how much RAM is used in the writing stage. Larger values of outputSNPBlockSize are written faster but use more RAM, so lowering it will reduce RAM. The default is set to 10000, but if you're running out of RAM, I would recommend dropping this to 1000 or 500 and seeing how it performs. Let me know!

Best,
Robbie
